name: Analytics Engineering
summary: PostgreSQL 16 with dbt-core and dbt-postgres, plus an optional lightweight Apache Airflow for orchestration projects.

services.name: workspace
services.purpose: Your development container: Python 3.12, dbt-core, dbt-postgres

services.name: airflow
services.purpose: Optional (compose profile `airflow`): Airflow standalone for scheduling

reset.label: Reset the warehouse database
reset.command: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait

limitations: Airflow is optional and off by default; it adds about 1 GB of memory (enable it with the `airflow` compose profile).
Airflow runs in standalone mode with a SQLite metadata database that is not kept when its container is recreated.
Airflow's container does not include dbt; the sample DAG shows the pattern only.
PostgreSQL is not published to your machine by default; connect from the workspace (host `postgres`).
